from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class DocumentCauseInfo(BaseModel):
    """A single finding from one document linking a title to a cause of action."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as identified in the text (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    identified_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action identified within the document")
    supporting_text: Optional[str] = Field(description="Short quote from the document supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extractions from a single document."""
    case_findings: List[DocumentCauseInfo] = Field(description="Extracted titles and their corresponding causes of action from the document")
